name: Empire State Fall Favorites 2023
information: **Competitors may only register for a maximum of 4 events.** If you register for more than 4 events, your registration will not be approved. Please see the Format Explanation tab for more info. [Empire State Fall Focus 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateFallFocus2023) is taking place the day after this competition, and you may compete in both if you wish.
